items: **Handshake & Tournament Formula & Method:** Total handshakes/matches among $n$ people = ${}^n\text{C}_2 = \frac{n(n-1)}{2}$.
**Circular Permutation:** Arrangements of $n$ distinct items in a circle = $(n-1)!$.

📝 **Worked Example (Handshake Formula Method):** 10 persons attend a conference and each person shakes hands with every other person once. Find total handshakes.
*Method:* Recognize Handshake pattern $\rightarrow$ Apply $\frac{n(n-1)}{2} = \frac{10 \times 9}{2} = 45\text{ handshakes}$.
